html:
Life Drain is a type of Magical Damage that cannot be used by players, only creatures. It is displayed in the game screen as Red Text, and it is similar to other magical damage in that it cannot be blocked, and is not reduced by your armor even though it looks the same as if you were taking Physical Damage due to the color text displayed. It is the same as Mana Drain, except it takes your hitpoints instead of mana.

Life Drain Protection

The following equipment reduces damage taken from Life Drain:

Helmets

There are no Helmets protecting against Life Drain.

Armors

There are no Armors protecting against Life Drain.

Legs

There are no Legs protecting against Life Drain.

Boots

There are no Boots protecting against Life Drain.
